d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi joined other leaders at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek, where terrorism, security, connectivity and regional cooperation were key issues. In this video, Firstpost examines four major moments from the summit, including PM Modi’s message against terrorism and his calls for dialogue and diplomacy, a widely circulated interaction between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, and the family photograph featuring Modi, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Putin. The video also covers the Bishkek Declaration,…
